scope: Independent read-only review of stage1 wrapper eligibility, bounds bridge, fallback semantics, input/output ownership and prospective complete-call benchmark boundary. No new test, import or timing acquisition by reviewer.

resolvedFindings.finding: An inherited fixedContentOffsetBase could invoke stock-visible accessors that native selection skipped.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Reject inherited presence when own descriptor is absent; targeted inherited getter/value cases preserve generic behavior.

resolvedFindings.finding: Public diagnostic native memory could also back input columns, so growth could detach inputs or staging writes could overwrite them.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Reject any input column whose buffer equals the helper memory before growth or copy; focused no-growth and growth cases assert fallback, unchanged buffer identity and unchanged bytes.

checks: The actual existing private-origin predicate is used via a hash-bound appended diagnostic export; its body is unchanged.
Intrinsic typed-array element kinds and bounds are checked; forged prototypes, shadows, shared/resizable buffers and unusual object paths fall back.
No await or caller-owned accessor separates admitted column inspection and copies.
Four input columns are copied into separate private ranges; malformed/unsupported native results fall back to the original stock encoder.
Result bytes are copied into a fresh owned buffer and remain independent of later native memory reuse/growth.
The observed twelve-call complete parity receipt binds this corrected wrapper and exact C/WASM and reports zero fallback.
benchmarkRequirements: A later cold observation must start before constructor Module compile, Memory allocation and Instance creation, and include one full corpus of complete encode calls.
Each timed encode call must include guards, layout and growth, four input copies, table zeroing/native work, result-header checks and owned output copy.
Capture decoding and factory reconstruction must be outside both arms identically; kernel-only timings do not qualify the helper.
Retain activation, fallback and copy/growth counters and compare all output bytes outside the timer.
limitations: No production integration or measured speedup exists at this stage.
Detailed C range/disjointness and format proof is separately owned by /root/pipeline_audit.
